decided: A sensor set to halt stops the run when either the current settings or the settings as they stood when building began say halt. Every other setting of a sensor is read only as it stood when building began.
alternatives: Read whether to halt only from the settings as they stood when building began.
Read whether to halt only from the current settings.
why: The run being watched cannot then switch a halt off, and the user can still switch one on part-way through a change; reading only the old settings would lock out the user, and reading only the current ones would let the run escape.
detail: on_fire is read from orbit/config.yaml in the working tree and at the fixed point; halt wins. exempt, per_file_lines and share_percent are read at the fixed point only (design M3, M9).
